name: Demand Response Load Reduction
description: Actual load reduction achieved by a demand response programme. Checks whether committed curtailment is delivered.

elements.name: Achieved Load Reduction
elements.description: Actual load reduction during a DR event. Uncertain due to customer participation rate and baseline estimation.

elements.name: Committed Load Reduction
elements.description: Contracted load reduction capacity sold to TSO

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(N_participants, P_per_participant) = N_participants · P_per_participant · participation_rate; affine in N
consistency_relations.upr_description: The achieved load reduction is an affine function of the number of active participants and their average load: ΔP_dr = N · P_avg · r_participation. This parametric mapping propagates the joint uncertainty in participation count and individual load through the aggregation formula into the total reduction domain, where it must meet the contracted commitment of 35 MW.
